items.title: Resilient IAM database authentication with Amazon Aurora Global Database writer endpoint
items.summary: Learn how to combine the Amazon Aurora Global Database writer endpoint with IAM database authentication so that passwordless access survives a cross-Region switchover or failover with no configuration changes. This walkthrough signs the token for the dynamically discovered primary Region and scopes the policy to every Regional cluster resource ID.
items.creator: Raunak Gupta

items.title: Building a multi-tenant CRM with Amazon Aurora DSQL
items.summary: Learn how to design and implement a multi-tenant CRM on Amazon Aurora DSQL using the pooled tenancy model. Tenant isolation is enforced in a centralized data-access layer, with Aurora DSQL-specific design considerations, and a working proof of concept you can deploy on Amazon ECS Express Mode.
items.creator: Aishwarya Sawant
